SIG_LG:8200,4,MMI:  Click Ok, then move the PTS and the Implementation Under Test (IUT) out of range of each other by performing one of the following IUT specific actions:
1. Hands Free (HF) IUT - Place the IUT in the RF sheild box or physically take out of range from the PTS. 
2. Audio Gateway (AG) IUT- Physically take the IUT out range.  Do not place in the RF sheild box as it will interfere with the network.
Note: The PTS can also be placed in the RF sheild box if necessary.
